sections.label: Sandy reef bed
sections.evidence: Tan bricks form a broad irregular footprint at y=0 and expand outward at y=1–2, spanning the ground beneath the station and neighboring reef.

sections.label: Reef shoulders
sections.evidence: Dark-gray masses rise beside the central footprint, with light-gray strips at x=8 and x=16 reaching y=6. Tan margins and a small orange growth remain within this region.

sections.label: Rocky station platform
sections.evidence: White and yellow station-floor pieces occupy the center above broad dark-gray outcrops. Interleaved tan edges, red coral and green growth complete the surrounding platform region.

sections.label: Cabin walls and windows
sections.evidence: Yellow floor and border pieces accompany white cabin walls. Blue bricks form front glazing at z=5–9 and rear glazing at z=17–19 through y=10.

sections.label: Cabin roof and mast
sections.evidence: White walls at y=11 narrow into the roof at y=12–13. Dark-gray #527–528 and #532–533 form a central cap, topped by yellow #534–535 at y=15–16.

sections.label: Cabin side walls
sections.evidence: Blue glazing and white edging occupy x=17–19, y=8–11. Subsequent white strips build the opposite side at x=6 over the same cabin height.

sections.label: Gray side panel
sections.evidence: Light-gray bricks form a panel at x=3–5, z=11–15, y=6–9. Adjacent yellow bricks create a vertical border at x=5.

sections.label: Window trim and antenna
sections.evidence: Yellow pieces extend matching front-window borders at x=9 and x=14. White #536–539 form central and lateral antenna elements at y=17.

sections.label: Left reef edge
sections.evidence: Tan pieces at x=0–3, y=1–2 continue into dark-gray rock at x=0–2 through y=7, outlining the outer left reef face.

sections.label: Orange coral growth
sections.evidence: An orange cluster rises near x=20, z=5, widens across x=18–23 through y=5–7, and narrows to a three-stud crown at y=8.

sections.label: Reef edge and antenna arms
sections.evidence: Tan and dark-gray pieces trace the right reef perimeter near x=22 and its rear edge at z=19. White #540–541 extend the antenna at y=17.
